description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeAnniversarySearchFilterParams, which extends a base FilterParams class. It contains properties and corresponding getter and setter methods for filtering employee anniversary data based on the current year, next anniversary date, and minimum and maximum date differences.

classes.name: EmployeeAnniversarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for encapsulating search filtering parameters related to employee anniversaries, including year, next date, and date difference range.

methods.name: getThisYear
methods.description: Returns the current year as a string.

methods.name: getNextDate
methods.description: Returns the next anniversary date as a DateTime object.
